meaning_en: to give up or leave completely
example_target: He abandoned his plan to travel abroad.
example_zh: 他放弃了出国旅行的计划。

meaning_en: to successfully reach a desired result through effort
example_target: She achieved her goal of graduating with honors.
example_zh: 她实现了以优异成绩毕业的目标。

meaning_en: a condition or circumstance that puts one in a favorable position
example_target: Living near the school is a big advantage.
example_zh: 住在学校附近是一个很大的优势。

meaning_en: to share or exchange information or ideas
example_target: It is important to communicate clearly with your team.
example_zh: 与团队清晰沟通很重要。

meaning_en: a conclusion reached after consideration
example_target: The committee made a decision to postpone the meeting.
example_zh: 委员会做出了推迟会议的决定。

meaning_en: the surroundings or conditions in which a person lives
example_target: We should protect the natural environment.
example_zh: 我们应该保护自然环境。

meaning_en: to set up on a permanent basis
example_target: The university was established in 1920.
example_zh: 这所大学建于1920年。

meaning_en: practical contact with events or activities
example_target: She has ten years of experience in teaching.
example_zh: 她有十年的教学经验。

meaning_en: a set of circumstances that makes it possible to do something
example_target: Education provides opportunities for a better career.
example_zh: 教育为更好的职业生涯提供了机会。

meaning_en: having an obligation to do something or having control over someone
example_target: The manager is responsible for the team's performance.
example_zh: 经理对团队的表现负有责任。

meaning_en: sufficiently great or important to be worthy of attention
example_target: There has been a significant increase in online shopping.
example_zh: 网上购物有了显著的增长。

meaning_en: a way of dealing with something; to come near
example_target: We need a different approach to solve this problem.
example_zh: 我们需要一种不同的方法来解决这个问题。

meaning_en: an advantage or profit gained from something
example_target: Exercise has many health benefits.
example_zh: 锻炼有很多健康好处。

meaning_en: a result or effect of an action or condition
example_target: Pollution is a consequence of industrial development.
example_zh: 污染是工业发展的后果。

meaning_en: to give something in order to help achieve something
example_target: Everyone should contribute to the community.
example_zh: 每个人都应该为社区做贡献。

meaning_en: to clearly show the existence or truth of something
example_target: The experiment demonstrates the effect of temperature on growth.
example_zh: 该实验展示了温度对生长的影响。

meaning_en: successful in producing a desired or intended result
example_target: This is an effective method for learning vocabulary.
example_zh: 这是学习词汇的有效方法。

meaning_en: a circumstance or influence that contributes to a result
example_target: Economic factors affect the housing market.
example_zh: 经济因素影响房地产市场。

meaning_en: single or particular; a single human being
example_target: Each individual has the right to express their opinion.
example_zh: 每个人都有表达自己观点的权利。

meaning_en: to carry out a systematic inquiry to discover facts
example_target: Police are investigating the cause of the accident.
example_zh: 警方正在调查事故原因。

meaning_en: to cause something to continue in its existing state
example_target: It is important to maintain a healthy lifestyle.
example_zh: 保持健康的生活方式很重要。

meaning_en: the greater number or more than half
example_target: The majority of students passed the exam.
example_zh: 大多数学生通过了考试。

meaning_en: a particular procedure for accomplishing something
example_target: Scientists use different methods to collect data.
example_zh: 科学家使用不同的方法来收集数据。

meaning_en: easily perceived or understood
example_target: It is obvious that the project needs more funding.
example_zh: 很明显这个项目需要更多资金。

meaning_en: to take part in an activity or event
example_target: All students are encouraged to participate in class discussions.
example_zh: 鼓励所有学生参加课堂讨论。

meaning_en: a fact or situation that is observed to exist
example_target: Global warming is a well-known phenomenon.
example_zh: 全球变暖是一个众所周知的现象。

meaning_en: having or showing the capacity to develop into something in the future
example_target: The company sees great potential in the new market.
example_zh: 公司看到了新市场的巨大潜力。

meaning_en: existing or occurring before in time or order
example_target: She had no previous experience in management.
example_zh: 她以前没有管理经验。

meaning_en: a series of actions or steps taken to achieve a particular end
example_target: Learning a language is a long process.
example_zh: 学习语言是一个漫长的过程。

meaning_en: to need something or make something necessary
example_target: This job requires strong communication skills.
example_zh: 这份工作需要很强的沟通能力。

meaning_en: the systematic investigation into materials and sources to establish facts
example_target: More research is needed to confirm the findings.
example_zh: 需要更多研究来证实这些发现。

meaning_en: a stock or supply of materials or assets
example_target: Water is a valuable natural resource.
example_zh: 水是一种宝贵的自然资源。

meaning_en: enough; adequate for the purpose
example_target: There is sufficient evidence to support the theory.
example_zh: 有足够的证据支持这一理论。

meaning_en: the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes
example_target: Technology has changed the way we communicate.
example_zh: 技术改变了我们的沟通方式。

meaning_en: existing in or as part of a tradition; long-established
example_target: Traditional teaching methods are being replaced by modern ones.
example_zh: 传统教学方法正在被现代方法所取代。

meaning_en: the quality or state of being different or diverse
example_target: The store offers a wide variety of products.
example_zh: 这家商店提供多种多样的产品。

meaning_en: a settled way of thinking or feeling about something
example_target: A positive attitude can lead to better results.
example_zh: 积极的态度可以带来更好的结果。

meaning_en: a class or division of people or things with shared characteristics
example_target: The questions can be divided into three categories.
example_zh: 这些问题可以分为三个类别。

meaning_en: to focus one's attention or effort on a particular object or activity
example_target: I need to concentrate on my studies.
example_zh: 我需要专心学习。

meaning_en: a serious disagreement or argument
example_target: The conflict between the two countries lasted for years.
example_zh: 两国之间的冲突持续了多年。

meaning_en: the customs, arts, and achievements of a particular people or society
example_target: Understanding different cultures is important in a global society.
example_zh: 在全球化社会中理解不同的文化很重要。

meaning_en: relating to the running of a home or to relations within a family
example_target: The government focuses on domestic economic policies.
example_zh: 政府专注于国内经济政策。

meaning_en: achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort
example_target: Public transport is more efficient than driving a car.
example_zh: 公共交通比开车更高效。

meaning_en: special importance or significance given to something
example_target: The emphasis of the course is on practical skills.
example_zh: 该课程的重点是实践技能。

meaning_en: forming a necessary base or core; of central importance
example_target: Freedom of speech is a fundamental human right.
example_zh: 言论自由是一项基本人权。

meaning_en: to cause something to arise or come about
example_target: Solar panels generate electricity from sunlight.
example_zh: 太阳能电池板利用阳光产生电力。

meaning_en: a marked effect or influence
example_target: The new policy will have a significant impact on education.
example_zh: 新政策将对教育产生重大影响。

meaning_en: an important topic or problem for debate
example_target: Climate change is a global issue that affects everyone.
example_zh: 气候变化是一个影响所有人的全球性问题。

meaning_en: a particular attitude towards or way of regarding something
example_target: Try to look at the problem from a different perspective.
example_zh: 试着从不同的角度看待这个问题。

meaning_en: a fundamental truth or proposition that serves as the foundation
example_target: The school operates on the principle of equal opportunity.
example_zh: 学校秉承机会平等的原则运作。

meaning_en: to distribute resources or duties for a particular purpose
example_target: The government allocated funds for education reform.
example_zh: 政府拨出资金用于教育改革。

meaning_en: a thing that is accepted as true without proof
example_target: The assumption that all students learn the same way is incorrect.
example_zh: 所有学生学习方式相同的假设是错误的。

meaning_en: disagreement, typically when prolonged and public
example_target: The new policy has caused a lot of controversy.
example_zh: 新政策引起了很多争议。

meaning_en: to make an action or process easier
example_target: Technology can facilitate communication between distant communities.
example_zh: 技术可以促进远距离社区之间的交流。

meaning_en: the basic physical structures and facilities needed for the operation of a society
example_target: The country needs to invest in its transport infrastructure.
example_zh: 国家需要投资交通基础设施。

meaning_en: to provide lodging or space for; to adapt to
example_target: The hotel can accommodate up to 500 guests.
example_zh: 这家酒店可以容纳多达500位客人。

meaning_en: to accept or admit the existence or truth of something
example_target: He acknowledged that the project had been poorly managed.
example_zh: 他承认这个项目管理不善。

meaning_en: to publicly recommend or support a particular policy or course of action
example_target: Many experts advocate renewable energy as the future.
example_zh: 许多专家提倡将可再生能源作为未来方向。

meaning_en: concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty
example_target: The building has great aesthetic appeal.
example_zh: 这座建筑具有很大的审美吸引力。

meaning_en: to work jointly on an activity or project
example_target: Researchers from different countries collaborated on the study.
example_zh: 来自不同国家的研究人员在这项研究上进行了合作。

meaning_en: a raw material or primary agricultural product that can be bought and sold
example_target: Oil is one of the most valuable commodities in the world.
example_zh: 石油是世界上最有价值的商品之一。

meaning_en: to give something in recognition of loss, suffering, or injury
example_target: Nothing can compensate for the loss of a loved one.
example_zh: 没有什么能弥补失去亲人的痛苦。

meaning_en: to deny the truth of a statement by asserting the opposite
example_target: The new evidence contradicts previous findings.
example_zh: 新证据与之前的发现相矛盾。

meaning_en: plural of criterion; standards by which something is judged
example_target: Applicants must meet certain criteria to be eligible.
example_zh: 申请者必须满足某些标准才有资格。

meaning_en: to arrive at a fact or conclusion by reasoning
example_target: From the evidence, we can deduce that he was guilty.
example_zh: 从证据中我们可以推断他有罪。

meaning_en: to make or become less
example_target: The supply of natural resources is diminishing rapidly.
example_zh: 自然资源的供应正在迅速减少。

meaning_en: involving many carefully arranged parts or details
example_target: She presented an elaborate plan for the new curriculum.
example_zh: 她提出了一个精心设计的新课程计划。

meaning_en: to completely remove or get rid of something
example_target: The goal is to eliminate poverty in the region.
example_zh: 目标是消除该地区的贫困。

meaning_en: to rise and fall irregularly in number or amount
example_target: Oil prices fluctuate depending on global demand.
example_zh: 石油价格根据全球需求波动。

meaning_en: to create or devise methodically
example_target: Scientists formulated a new theory to explain the phenomenon.
example_zh: 科学家制定了一个新理论来解释这一现象。

meaning_en: a system in which members are ranked according to status
example_target: There is a strict hierarchy within the organization.
example_zh: 该组织内部有严格的等级制度。

meaning_en: a proposed explanation made as a starting point for further investigation
example_target: The researchers tested their hypothesis through experiments.
example_zh: 研究人员通过实验验证了他们的假设。

meaning_en: to put a decision or plan into effect
example_target: The school will implement the new policy next term.
example_zh: 学校将在下学期实施新政策。

meaning_en: a thing that motivates or encourages one to do something
example_target: Tax incentives attract businesses to the area.
example_zh: 税收激励吸引企业到该地区。

meaning_en: the occurrence or rate of something, especially something unwelcome
example_target: The incidence of obesity has increased in recent years.
example_zh: 近年来肥胖症的发生率有所增加。

meaning_en: to take in or contain something as part of a whole
example_target: We need to incorporate feedback from our customers.
example_zh: 我们需要纳入客户的反馈意见。

meaning_en: existing in something as a permanent or essential characteristic
example_target: There are inherent risks in any investment.
example_zh: 任何投资都有固有的风险。

meaning_en: the action of becoming involved in a situation to alter its course
example_target: Government intervention in the economy is sometimes necessary.
example_zh: 政府干预经济有时是必要的。

meaning_en: conforming to the law or to rules
example_target: They have a legitimate reason to be concerned.
example_zh: 他们有正当的理由感到担忧。

meaning_en: to reduce something to the smallest possible amount
example_target: We should minimize the use of plastic packaging.
example_zh: 我们应该尽量减少塑料包装的使用。

meaning_en: in spite of that; however
example_target: The task was difficult; nevertheless, she completed it on time.
example_zh: 任务很困难；然而，她按时完成了。

meaning_en: a conception of or belief about something
example_target: The notion that success depends solely on talent is misleading.
example_zh: 成功完全取决于天赋的观念是具有误导性的。

meaning_en: to become aware of through the senses; to interpret in a particular way
example_target: The public perceives crime as the biggest problem.
example_zh: 公众认为犯罪是最大的问题。

meaning_en: denoting an action or event preceding the main one
example_target: Preliminary results suggest the treatment is effective.
example_zh: 初步结果表明该治疗是有效的。

meaning_en: present as the strongest or main element
example_target: English is the predominant language in international business.
example_zh: 英语是国际商务中的主要语言。

meaning_en: a part or share of a whole
example_target: A large proportion of the population lives in urban areas.
example_zh: 大部分人口生活在城市地区。

meaning_en: to seek to attain or accomplish a goal
example_target: She decided to pursue a career in medicine.
example_zh: 她决定从事医学事业。

meaning_en: a set of reasons or a logical basis for a course of action
example_target: What is the rationale behind this decision?
example_zh: 这个决定背后的理由是什么？

meaning_en: to prove a statement or theory to be wrong or false
example_target: The scientist refuted the claims made by the media.
example_zh: 这位科学家驳斥了媒体的说法。

meaning_en: a written outline of events; a postulated sequence of events
example_target: In the worst-case scenario, we could lose everything.
example_zh: 在最坏的情况下，我们可能会失去一切。

meaning_en: coming after something in time; following
example_target: Subsequent events confirmed the initial report.
example_zh: 随后的事件证实了最初的报告。

meaning_en: of considerable importance, size, or worth
example_target: There has been a substantial increase in house prices.
example_zh: 房价有了大幅上涨。

meaning_en: something added to complete or enhance something
example_target: Many people take vitamin supplements to stay healthy.
example_zh: 许多人服用维生素补充剂来保持健康。

meaning_en: to strengthen or support physically; to maintain over time
example_target: It is difficult to sustain economic growth in the long term.
example_zh: 长期维持经济增长是困难的。

meaning_en: to bring to an end
example_target: The contract was terminated due to a breach of terms.
example_zh: 合同因违反条款而被终止。

meaning_en: to damage or weaken gradually or insidiously
example_target: Corruption undermines public trust in government.
example_zh: 腐败逐渐削弱公众对政府的信任。

meaning_en: in contrast or comparison with the fact that
example_target: Some people prefer city life, whereas others enjoy the countryside.
example_zh: 有些人喜欢城市生活，而另一些人喜欢乡村。

meaning_en: to produce or provide; to give way to demands or pressure
example_target: The experiment yielded unexpected results.
example_zh: 实验产生了意想不到的结果。

meaning_en: open to more than one interpretation; not clear
example_target: The wording of the contract is deliberately ambiguous.
example_zh: 合同的措辞故意含糊不清。

meaning_en: complete; including all or nearly all elements or aspects
example_target: The report provides a comprehensive overview of the situation.
example_zh: 该报告提供了对情况的全面概述。

meaning_zh: 经验主义的，以实验为依据的
meaning_en: based on observation or experience rather than theory
example_target: Empirical evidence supports the effectiveness of the treatment.
example_zh: 经验证据支持该治疗的有效性。

meaning_en: a typical example or pattern of something; a model
example_target: The discovery led to a paradigm shift in the field of physics.
example_zh: 这一发现导致了物理学领域的范式转变。

meaning_en: dealing with things sensibly and realistically
example_target: We need a pragmatic approach to solving this problem.
example_zh: 我们需要一种务实的方法来解决这个问题。

meaning_en: something that deviates from what is standard or expected
example_target: The sudden drop in temperature was an anomaly in the data.
example_zh: 气温的突然下降是数据中的一个异常。

meaning_en: based on random choice rather than reason
example_target: The selection of participants was completely arbitrary.
example_zh: 参与者的选择完全是任意的。

meaning_en: to state a fact or belief confidently and forcefully
example_target: The author asserts that the theory is outdated.
example_zh: 作者断言该理论已经过时了。

meaning_en: a person or thing that precipitates a change
example_target: The economic crisis acted as a catalyst for reform.
example_zh: 经济危机充当了改革的催化剂。

meaning_en: logical and consistent; forming a unified whole
example_target: She presented a coherent argument in her essay.
example_zh: 她在文章中提出了一个连贯的论点。

meaning_en: making a certain situation or outcome likely or possible
example_target: A quiet environment is conducive to effective studying.
example_zh: 安静的环境有助于有效学习。

meaning_en: an opinion or conclusion formed on the basis of incomplete information
example_target: His claims are based on pure conjecture without evidence.
example_zh: 他的说法纯粹是基于没有证据的猜测。

meaning_en: to combine or strengthen into a single more effective whole
example_target: The company plans to consolidate its market position.
example_zh: 该公司计划巩固其市场地位。

meaning_en: to confirm or give support to a statement or theory
example_target: The witness's testimony corroborated the defendant's account.
example_zh: 证人的证词证实了被告的陈述。

meaning_en: to describe or portray something precisely
example_target: The report delineates the boundaries of the research area.
example_zh: 该报告勾画了研究领域的边界。

meaning_en: a lack of compatibility or similarity between two or more facts
example_target: There is a discrepancy between the two reports.
example_zh: 两份报告之间存在差异。

meaning_en: to spread information widely
example_target: The internet helps to disseminate knowledge globally.
example_zh: 互联网有助于在全球范围内传播知识。

meaning_en: fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing
example_target: She gave an eloquent speech about human rights.
example_zh: 她发表了一篇关于人权的雄辩演讲。

meaning_en: to surround and have or hold within
example_target: The course encompasses all aspects of business management.
example_zh: 该课程涵盖了商务管理的所有方面。

meaning_en: to make a problem or situation worse
example_target: The drought exacerbated the food shortage.
example_zh: 干旱加剧了粮食短缺。

meaning_en: to extend the application of a method or conclusion to an unknown situation
example_target: We can extrapolate future trends from the existing data.
example_zh: 我们可以从现有数据推断未来趋势。

meaning_en: possible to do easily or conveniently
example_target: It is not feasible to build a new airport in that location.
example_zh: 在那个地点建造新机场是不可行的。

meaning_en: diverse in character or content
example_target: The population of the city is highly heterogeneous.
example_zh: 该城市的人口高度异质化。

meaning_en: treating all rivals or disputants equally; fair and just
example_target: A judge must be impartial in all cases.
example_zh: 法官在所有案件中都必须公正不偏。

meaning_en: absolutely necessary; essential
example_target: Water is indispensable to human survival.
example_zh: 水对人类生存是不可或缺的。

meaning_en: the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles
example_target: Academic integrity is fundamental to university life.
example_zh: 学术诚信是大学生活的根本。

meaning_en: belonging naturally; essential
example_target: Curiosity is an intrinsic part of human nature.
example_zh: 好奇心是人性的固有组成部分。

meaning_en: to place close together for contrasting effect
example_target: The artist juxtaposes light and dark to create dramatic effect.
example_zh: 艺术家将明暗并置以创造戏剧效果。

meaning_en: producing a great deal of profit
example_target: Real estate can be a lucrative investment.
example_zh: 房地产可以是一项有利可图的投资。

meaning_en: showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise
example_target: She is meticulous in her research methodology.
example_zh: 她在研究方法上一丝不苟。

meaning_en: to make less severe, serious, or painful
example_target: Measures were taken to mitigate the environmental damage.
example_zh: 采取了措施来减轻环境破坏。

meaning_en: a subtle difference in meaning, expression, or sound
example_target: The translation fails to capture the nuances of the original text.
example_zh: 这个翻译未能捕捉到原文的细微差别。

meaning_en: no longer produced or used; out of date
example_target: Typewriters have become obsolete in the digital age.
example_zh: 打字机在数字时代已经过时了。

meaning_en: to make something continue indefinitely
example_target: The media can perpetuate negative stereotypes.
example_zh: 媒体可能会使负面刻板印象持续下去。

meaning_en: seeming reasonable or probable
example_target: His explanation sounds plausible but lacks evidence.
example_zh: 他的解释听起来合理但缺乏证据。

meaning_en: to increase rapidly in number
example_target: Social media platforms have proliferated over the past decade.
example_zh: 社交媒体平台在过去十年中激增。

meaning_en: a consequence of an action or event
example_target: The policy has far-reaching ramifications for the economy.
example_zh: 该政策对经济有深远的衍生影响。

meaning_en: to restore friendly relations; to make compatible
example_target: It is difficult to reconcile these two conflicting viewpoints.
example_zh: 很难调和这两个相互矛盾的观点。

meaning_en: to examine or inspect closely and thoroughly
example_target: The auditors scrutinized the company's financial records.
example_zh: 审计人员仔细审查了公司的财务记录。

meaning_en: to combine a number of things into a coherent whole
example_target: The paper synthesizes findings from multiple studies.
example_zh: 这篇论文综合了多项研究的发现。

meaning_en: perceptible by touch; clear and definite
example_target: The project has brought tangible benefits to the community.
example_zh: 该项目给社区带来了切实的好处。

meaning_en: very weak or slight; insubstantial
example_target: The connection between the two events is tenuous at best.
example_zh: 这两个事件之间的联系充其量是薄弱的。

meaning_en: never done or known before
example_target: The pandemic caused unprecedented disruption to global travel.
example_zh: 疫情对全球旅行造成了史无前例的干扰。

meaning_en: present, appearing, or found everywhere
example_target: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern society.
example_zh: 智能手机在现代社会已变得无处不在。

meaning_en: to clear someone of blame or suspicion
example_target: New evidence vindicated the accused man.
example_zh: 新证据证明被告是无辜的。

meaning_en: liable to change rapidly and unpredictably
example_target: The stock market has been very volatile this year.
example_zh: 今年股市一直非常不稳定。

meaning_en: satisfactory or acceptable in quality or quantity
example_target: The school does not have adequate funding for new equipment.
example_zh: 学校没有足够的资金购买新设备。

meaning_en: to suppose something to be the case without proof
